candidates.tagline: The $2.1B stadium where 'obstructed view' is a design feature
candidates.story: Buffalo's new $2.1B Highmark Stadium opened in 2026 with hundreds of seats blocked by safety railings; after viral complaints, the architect insisted the obstructed views are intentional, not a design flaw.
candidates.why_funny: The architect's defence — 'You will find some level of obstruction in every stadium in the world' — is the classic 'it's a feature, not a bug' for a $2.1B construction project.
candidates.alt: Interior wide shot of the new Buffalo Bills Highmark Stadium packed with fans during a football event

candidates.tagline: $499 to livestream your own cavities — 661 engineers, 6 years
candidates.story: Dyson's September 2026 CameraJet is a $499 electric toothbrush with a built-in Wi-Fi camera that streams live footage of your molars to your phone; it took six years and 661 engineers to build.
candidates.why_funny: Dyson rebranded a dental endoscope as a toothbrush, filed 38 patents, and expected the public to pay $499 to watch their own teeth in real time.
candidates.alt: Person holding the Dyson CameraJet electric toothbrush with its built-in camera visible near the brush head
